Projects & collaborations

Occupational & digital health

Firefighter health, duty load & recovery

Ongoing collaboration

Working with Fan-Yun Lan’s team and the Taoyuan City Fire Department (桃園市政府消防局) to combine Garmin, continuous glucose monitoring, and duty records in occupational health research.

  • CGM
  • Garmin wearables
  • Occupational health
My role & project details

Partner communication, study planning, data pipelines, and policy-related writing. The next research questions concern physiological responses to duty and opportunities for recovery; the protocol poster is accepted for ICOH 2027.
